slp_intro: Organize and search the servers in your multiplayer list. A client-side mod for Fabric and NeoForge. Your server list itself stays untouched, so without the mod it is exactly as before.
slp_feature_folders: Folders as tabs, including ones that fill themselves from a search
slp_feature_search: Search with filters for tags, ping, players and playtime
slp_feature_notes: Notes, tags and playtime for every server
slp_facts_source: From Modrinth and GitHub through the lab feed.
slp_shot_list: The server list with folders as tabs
slp_donate_text: Every new Minecraft version means porting and testing. Donations pay for that time.
